name: passport
description: The fleet's one auth protocol. A caller signs in once (wallet, local key, or a build console session) and every module recognises them: modules ask passport who a token belongs to instead of each carrying its own verifier. The protocol lives in protocol.json + src/schemes.py and is re-read on change, so editing it changes the whole system on the next request with no restarts. Ships a Python client (2-line adoption, falls back to an in-process verify when the service is down) and a browser SDK (/passport/passport.js) that shares one sign-in across consoles and adopts the build console's session.
state: none on disk — verdicts cached in memory for cache_ttl seconds
